svg.title: Tech stack: Backend, Frontend, Languages and Tools
svg.desc: Technologies I am learning and using. Backend: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Prisma, Passport.js, JWT, Swagger, OAuth, TOTP, MFA, Rate Limiting.
